description: This Java class defines the 'AcknowledgeInd' PDU used for MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service) acknowledgments within the Android messaging library. It provides methods to construct, access, and modify the relevant headers for the acknowledgment indication message.

classes.name: AcknowledgeInd
classes.description: Represents the MMS AcknowledgeInd PDU, providing constructors and accessor methods for relevant headers.

methods.name: AcknowledgeInd
methods.description: Constructor for creating an acknowledgment PDU with specified MMS version and transaction ID.

methods.name: AcknowledgeInd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PDU with provided headers.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID associated with this acknowledgment.

methods.name: setTransactionId
methods.description: Sets the transaction ID for this acknowledgment.
